Heard on I.A No.5889/2024 an application under Section 302(1) of the Cr.P.C.
For the reasons stated in the application, the victim is permitted to represent the case through counsel.
opennyai_summary.10_February_2025__facts:
The appellant/accused has been convicted under Section 376(2)(K), 376(2)(F), 376(3), 323 and 506 part-II of the IPC and Section 5(n)/6 of the POCSO Act, 2012 and sentenced for Life Imprisonment,
Life 2 CRA-15607-2023 Imprisonment, Life Imprisonment, 01 year R.I, 01 year R.I, Life Imprisonment to run concurrently with fine and default stipulations respectively.
The sole appellant has been convicted vide judgment dated 28.06.2023 passed in Special Case No.178/2021 by XVth Additional Sessions Judge and Special Judge, POCSO, Indore for committing sexual assault towards victim (PW-1) who is below the age of 16 years on 02.07.2021 on the basis of date of birth i.e.
27.10.2005.
Appellant/accused is the biological father of the victim (PW-1).
The judgment and conviction of sentence has been passed without considering the contradictions in the evidence presented before the trial Court.
opennyai_summary.10_February_2025__ANALYSIS:
The trial Court has committed error in discarding the defence version.
The appellant/accused has filed the copy of statement of bank account of mother of the victim as well as the copy of statement of bank account of appellant/accused.
opennyai_summary.10_February_2025__decision:
The final hearing of the appeal would take considerable long time for its disposal hence, its prayed that application be allowed.
Considering the statement of victim (PW-1) and her mother (PW-2), we are not inclined to suspend the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant/accused at present.
